questions: This painful collection of pus built up within body tissue often causes redness, warmth, and swelling, and includes boils and carbuncles as common types — what is it called?
Abscess: Localized collection of pus in body tissue. An abscess is a collection of pus that has built up within the tissue of the body, usually caused by bacterial infection.
A versatile Spanish midfielder who debuted for Barcelona at just 18, he went on to win seven La Liga titles and two Champions Leagues there before earning his first cap for Spain in 2016 — who is he?

This is the psychedelic music project of Australian multi-instrumentalist Kevin Parker, who writes, records, and produces everything himself in the studio despite touring with a full band — name the project?

Tame Impala is the psychedelic music project of Australian singer and multi-instrumentalist Kevin Parker. Originally signed to Modular Recordings, Tame Impala signed in 2015 to Interscope Records in the United States and Fiction Records in the United Kingdom.
Which of these has the largest population?
Hispaniola has the greatest population of the four (21.4 million).
Founded in San Sebastián in 1919, this couture house relocated to Paris in 1937 after the Spanish Civil War, closed in 1968, and was later revived — which luxury fashion brand is it?
Balenciaga: France-based Spanish luxury fashion house.
Born in Boston, this colonial portrait painter of wealthy New Englanders moved to London in 1774 — never returning to America — and pioneered history paintings in modern dress. Who was he?
John Singleton Copley: American-born British painter (1738–1815)
Son of a director and a screenwriter and younger brother to a fellow actor, this performer broke through as Homer Hickam in October Sky and a troubled teen in Donnie Darko. Who is he?
Jake Gyllenhaal (born December 19, 1980) is an American actor whose career on screen and stage has spanned more than three decades.
